format: All Competition OS events (Studio, Custom and body-declared)
requirement: An event that holds scoring evidence (ballots, marks, results, publications, advancement or exclusion decisions, corrections and their audit) cannot be hard-deleted by any path, including organizer-delete cascades and truncate. Events without such evidence keep their existing authorization-controlled deletion; non-competition events are unchanged. Archive or hide through event status (cancelled/completed) and visibility (private).
enforcement_point: Database triggers on public.events (ENABLE ALWAYS). Git-only: not applied to DEV or PROD.

tests.name: OD-04 migration contains no retention timer and deletes nothing
OD-04 rollback removes exactly what the migration creates and touches no table

interpretation_notes: DanceFlow policy decided by the owner on 2026-11-23 (OD-04). Local SQL suite and race results are recorded in the PR; status stays unverified until the migration is independently reviewed, merged and applied (owner gates). Trigger disablement by the table owner or a superuser is an accepted residual risk.
